translations.web: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
translations.bsb: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.
translations.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
translations.asv: Then entered in therefore the other disciple also, who came first to the tomb, and he saw, and believed.
